description: Make Mermaid diagrams portable. Takes HTML containing <div class="mermaid"> blocks (or a raw Mermaid source) and returns the same document with every diagram pre-rendered to inline SVG and the Mermaid CDN runtime stripped. A CDN-backed diagram only renders if the reader can fetch and run the runtime; inline SVG needs neither, so the output survives offline readers, email clients, Notion/Confluence (which strip <script>), and PDF export. Rendering happens on our infrastructure; diagram content is not sent to any third party.

html.description: HTML document or fragment containing <div class="mermaid"> blocks. Mutually exclusive with mermaid_source.

inject_lightbox.description: Add click-to-enlarge overlay CSS+JS for small-text diagrams. Default false.

mermaid_source.description: A single raw Mermaid diagram source. Mutually exclusive with html.

output_format.description: Default "html". "svg" returns the raw inline SVG and requires mermaid_source.

name: convert_diagram
